unavoidable_search_exposure: Search/abstract snippets exposed effect prose and N. Full open requested metadata lines0 yielded first562lines, including abstract, figure captions and introduction; not Methods/results tables. Baseline agent sent N231/timepressure and45minute design details to root before freeze. Effect direction, outcome counts and joinability not used for selection; cannot claim pristine blinding.
date_note: Publication sort uses author-identified original publication month where available, then issue date with explicit precision. Bichler author-upload metadata says2019-12; Crossref and LMU say2020-10. DOI-created2019-12-02 is retained only as registry creation, never fabricated publication day. Pillai authorOSF original_publication_date2020-10-10; Crossref2020-12. Choosing consistent issue dates also puts Bichler before Pillai. Mixed-source interpretation (Bichler unknownOctober day versus PillaiOctober10) leaves within-month ambiguity; selection operational, not proof of exhaustive earliest study.
selection_evidence_scope: Eligibility based on titles, abstracts, public file list, publication metadata; no deliberate Methods/results/data reads before freeze. Indexed timing-token search and tool-returned intro/captions exposed additional text, explicitly logged.
